items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: Bill Matthews and them Warren's drummer in the brass band... I was the youngest one in the band.

ctx.x: You had a brass band too, didn't you?

Well, McCullen did. But I never played in a brass band. I played with Joyce McCullen Orchestra. So, several nights, we had a rehearsal at my house on 4th Street. At the time, Bill Matthews and them Warren's drummer in the brass band, which is the Excelsior Band. You heard talk of the Excelsior Brass Band. Well, I was the youngest one in the band. I think I was 16 and a half years, 17 years old. The youngest man in the band.
Who else was in that? Who was the leader?
